container.built_from: docker-daemon (local image; the shipped definition.def uses Bootstrap: docker, which resolves once the tag is pushed)

build_wall_s.note: docker wall is a rebuild with the builder stage cached; the cold build including the weight bake was substantially longer

isolation.meaning: no host $HOME, no host /tmp, no host HF cache, no route to the Hub — a fold can only succeed on baked weights

1stp.description: Streptavidin, 159 aa SEQRES, biotin as CCD BTN

ligand_BTN_heavy_atom_rmsd_A.note: superposed on protein CA frame; atoms matched by name

1stp.note: 121 of 159 residues are ordered in the experimental entry; comparison is over those 121

vram_headroom.observed: 13.98 GB at 76 tokens, 15.75 GB at 175 tokens on a 16.0 GB card
vram_headroom.implication: the full trunk leaves ~0.6 GB at 175 tokens. Longer targets will OOM with chunk_size None; use --model fast, or set a chunk size, for sequences much beyond ~200 tokens on 16 GB.
